usage.outputShape: Untested. Upstream is PDL v5/person/enrich, so expect body.data (full person profile: work history, education, skills, social profiles) and body.status / body.likelihood; exact shape unverified.
quirks: GET endpoint — identifiers go in the query string, NOT a JSON body. At least one of name/first_name+last_name/email/phone/lid/profile/company is required.

COULD NOT PAY-TEST: qa-pay's Sponge paidFetch fails with 'Sponge payment failed: Body already used' on every attempt (3x), even for a GET with no body — the request stream is consumed on the 402 pre-flight and reused on the paid retry. This is a payment-tool/infra bug, NOT an endpoint problem. No USDC was spent (paid:false all 3 times).
Endpoint is confirmed ALIVE and payable: raw curl returns a clean x402 v1 402 with full outputSchema. payTo 0x19a09691d0A9c4fB80Cc40694704a15858C6A454, asset USDC base, 350000 (=$0.35).
Upstream resource in the 402 is https://api.peopledatalabs.com/v5/person/enrich (Orthogonal gateway proxying People Data Labs).
usage.guide: People Data Labs person-enrich proxied through the Orthogonal x402 gateway. Call it as a plain GET with one or more identifier query params (profile/email/name/lid/phone/company); the response is the enriched PDL person record (data.* with work history, education, skills, social profiles). Price is $0.35 USDC on Base, x402, no API key. NOTE: this run could not complete a live paid call — the qa-pay/Sponge paidFetch layer throws 'Body already used' on every attempt (no money spent), so output shape is inferred not verified. Re-test once the wallet bug is fixed.
